manifest.description: Cartoon-style animated git graph for any GitHub repository, powered by three.js.

viewer.loadingSub: the little balls are lining up
viewer.emptySub: Make a commit and a ball will pop out!
viewer.crashSub: Something in the data looks off. Reloading usually fixes it.
viewer.webglFail: WebGL is not available in this browser.
viewer.refreshFailed: Refresh failed; showing the previous data.

errors.invalid_repo: Could not recognise this repository name.
errors.not_found: Repository not found. For private repos add a token in settings.
errors.unauthorized: Token is invalid or lacks permission.
errors.rate_limited: GitHub API rate limit reached (60/h without a token).
errors.network: Network error. Please check your connection.

viewer.addToken: Add a token to raise the limit to 5,000/h

diag.title: Compare & changes
diag.head: Head
diag.failed: Query unavailable. Retry or check source permissions.
diag.ancestor: Base is an ancestor of head
diag.note: Ancestry does not establish patch equivalence, current effectiveness, or deployment.
diag.select: Select a commit to inspect parent → commit changes.
diag.none: No entries in the complete list.
diag.incomplete: This list cannot establish absence of changes.
diag.disabled: This source provides a snapshot only; compare & changes are unavailable.
diag.textMissing: Text patch unavailable: binary, large, or omitted by the provider.
diag.localRemote: Remote refs are local observations. No fetch was run.

reasonLabels.default_branch_unavailable: Default branch not found; the main line is missing
reasonLabels.tags_unavailable: Tag query failed; full list unknown
reasonLabels.exact_patch_unavailable: This Git environment cannot guarantee exact single-file diff scope
reasonLabels.no_common_ancestor: No common ancestor; file comparison unavailable
reasonLabels.multiple_merge_bases: Multiple merge bases; no file base selected

web.themeFailed: The theme could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry.
web.tokenHelp: Anonymous requests are limited to 60 GitHub API calls per hour. A token raises that to 5,000 and unlocks private repos.
web.tokenWarn: Use a fine-grained token limited to the repos you want to view, with only Contents: Read-only and Metadata: Read-only. Never use a token with write access. It is stored in this browser’s localStorage and sent only to api.github.com.
web.tokenConflict: GitHub token was changed in another tab, so nothing was saved. The current settings are loaded; review them and retry.
web.tokenSaveFailed: Could not confirm saving settings. Allow browser storage and retry.
web.localHint: Reading your local git history; the view updates when you commit.
web.reposTruncated: …scan limit reached (set AGG_REPO_ROOTS to pick folders)
web.reposFailed: Could not load the repository list

pathErrors.not_absolute: Enter an absolute path (~ for your home folder works).
pathErrors.not_git: That folder is not inside a git repository.
pathErrors.unsafe_repo: Git refuses to open this repository because it belongs to another user (trust it with: git config --global --add safe.directory <path>).
pathErrors.failed: Could not open it (the dev server did not respond).

web.localUnknown: The dev server does not know this local repository (it may have moved, been deleted, or fallen outside the scanned folders after a restart). Pick one from the menu above.
web.localOffline: Cannot reach the dev server to read this local repository.
web.localFailed: Could not read the local git history.
web.localOnly: Other local repositories can only be chosen and read on the computer running the dev server.

historyErrors.offline: the dev server did not respond
historyErrors.unknown: the dev server does not know this repository
historyErrors.localOnly: it can only be read on the computer running the dev server

snapshotErrors.missing_dir: The folder of this repository does not exist (it may have been moved or deleted).
snapshotErrors.not_git: This folder is not inside a git repository.
snapshotErrors.no_git: git was not found: make sure it is installed and on your PATH.
snapshotErrors.unsafe_repo: Git refuses to open this repository because it belongs to another user (trust it with: git config --global --add safe.directory <path>).
snapshotErrors.git_error: Could not read the git history (git reported an error). The details are in the terminal running the dev server or the build.

options.title: Adorable Git Graph settings
options.tokenHelp: Anonymous requests are limited to 60 GitHub API calls per hour. A token raises that to 5,000 and unlocks private repositories.
options.tokenWarn: Use a fine-grained token limited to the repositories you want to view, with only Contents: Read-only and Metadata: Read-only. It is stored only in the local extension storage of this browser and sent solely to api.github.com. Never use a token with write access.
options.maxCommits: Commits fetched per branch (also per batch when scrolling back)
options.consent: Without consent to send authentication info, the token is not saved or used.
